assets.name: tree_oak
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached single game asset. Redesign it to be a LITTLE MORE CARTOON and noticeably MORE COLORFUL while keeping a cohesive charming 16-bit pixel-art game style and overhead camera. Preserve the asset type, centered single-object composition, orientation, and usable silhouette; no scene, text, faces or extra props. Greatly simplify internal texture into large clean clusters and rounded readable lobes. Crisp square pixel stair-step edges, 5-7 FLAT colors, no painterly shading, gradients, noise or dithering. Friendly clear silhouettes and saturated midtones, top-left highlights. Actual transparent PNG outside the sprite (not a black or checkerboard background). Keep all edges inside generous transparent margins. Rounded broad oak canopy, direct top-down without trunk. Bright emerald and grassy green body, yellow-green rounded highlights, rich teal outlines (not black). 5-6 broad scalloped leaf masses with a few simple marks, NOT hundreds of tiny leaves. Designed to read at 56x56 pixels.

assets.name: ground_moss
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: attached ground tile. Make it a more colorful slightly cartoon pixel-art grass ground for a top-down game. Preserve opaque full square seamless repeatable texture. Change muddy olive to a fresh medium grass green (roughly #69AD45) with only two nearby green shades. VERY quiet texture: about 85 percent plain base color, a handful of small simple stylized grass tufts with low contrast and generous empty spacing. Crisp flat square pixel clusters, no gradients, no dithering, no grain, no lighting variation across tile, no vignette. Not neon. No stones, trees, flowers, characters, text or borders. Must read as a clean 64x64 game tile when reduced.
